## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the release gate's off-by-one comparison before merge: a release with exactly the minimum number of approvals is now blocked, and that breaks the documented "at least" rule.

## Changes
The pull request regenerates `aaa-generated/catalog.json`, renaming all 1,500 `legacy-service-NNNN` entries to `production-service-NNNN` and moving their ports from 1xxxx to 2xxxx, and it adds a top-level `review_note` string entry. It also changes `healthy()` in `services/registry.py` from `len(failures) == 0` to `not failures`, and changes `approved()` in `zzz-release/gate.py` from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` so exactly `minimum` approvals passes — With `approvals=2, minimum=2`, `approved()` now returns `False`. The module docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1` says "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." The tests use 3 and 1 approvals, so they don't cover the boundary at 2 and still pass. — Every release with exactly the required number of approvals is blocked, so each one needs an extra approver. — Fix: Revert to `approvals >= minimum` and add a `gate.approved(2, minimum=2)` case to `test_approved_release` in `tests/test_release.py`.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Remove the non-service `review_note` key from the catalog — Any code that loops over the catalog and reads `entry["port"]` or `entry["enabled"]` fails on the top-level `"review_note"` key, because its value is a string while all 1,500 other entries are objects with those fields. The PR describes this file as regenerated, but this key isn't service data. — A deployment consumer that iterates the catalog raises a TypeError, and the next real regeneration silently drops the key.

## Not reviewed
- This review read lines 2234–8979 of the `aaa-generated/catalog.json` diff only through a pattern count: 6,000 of the 6,013 changed lines match the rename and port pattern, and the other 13 were read individually.
- No code in this repository reads `aaa-generated/catalog.json`, so the consumers of the renamed service names and the new 2xxxx ports were not available to check.
